# hg discord

**What this page tells you:** every `hg discord` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The discord gateway, observed from outside (hermes-native; eve's discord is the connection gateway's).

## Synopsis

```text
hg discord status [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Declaration, token/authz env BINDING (names only, never values), and the adapter's own `gateway.log` connect lines from the pod. Refuses on an Eve profile - the connection gateway owns Discord there (`hg connection prove`, and `hg agent prove` legs EVE021/EVE024).

## `hg discord status`

```text
hg discord status [flags]
```

Gateway declaration + binding + connect evidence.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
